Definition
[Infinitesimal generator] ↗ def:semigroup-contraction-semigroup 1. ch7:7.4.1-def-2\group Semigroup Theory

Write \[ D(A) := \left\{ u \in X \mid \lim _{t \to 0+} \frac{S(t)u - u}{t} \text{ exists in } X\right\} \tag {8} \] and \[ Au := \lim _{t \to 0+} \frac{S(t)u - u}{t} \quad (u \in D(A)). \tag {9} \] We call $A : D(A) \to X$ the (infinitesimal) generator of the semigroup $\{ S(t)\} _{t \geq 0}$; $D(A)$ is the domain of $A$.
